transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I'm here today because I've been feeling extremely overwhelmed, anxious, and down lately. I'm really struggling to cope with everything right now and felt like I needed some help.
How long have you been feeling this overwhelmed, anxious, and down? Did it start after a specific stressful event or has it been going on most days for a long time?
I've been feeling like this for about three weeks now. It definitely started recently, right after a very stressful event happened in my life.
What was the stressful event, and since it happened, how much has it affected your work, school, relationships, or daily routine?

It's hard for me to pin down the exact event right now, but everything just feels completely thrown off. I've been feeling so overwhelmed lately that I'm not even sure how to measure its impact on my daily routine yet.
Did something traumatic happen—like threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence—and since then have you had unwanted memories, nightmares, or felt like you were reliving it?

No, nothing traumatic like that happened, and I haven't experienced any violence or serious injury. I don't have any nightmares or flashbacks of reliving an event. It's just a different kind of life stress that has been wearing me down.
Over the past two weeks, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, I have been feeling incredibly down and low in mood nearly every day, and I find myself getting tearful very easily. This has been going on for about three weeks now, and I just can't seem to find pleasure in the things I usually enjoy.
Over the past six months, have you been worrying excessively about several different parts of your life on most days, even before this recent stress started?

No, I definitely haven't been worrying like this for the past six months. This anxiety and worry only started about three weeks ago, right after that stressful event happened. Before that, I was doing just fine and managing my life normally.
Along with feeling down and losing interest, have you also had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, or thoughts of death or suicide?

No, I haven't really experienced those specific changes in my sleep or appetite, and I definitely haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself. Mostly, I just feel very down, tearful, and completely hopeless about everything right now.
Even though this started after a stressor, are your symptoms severe enough that you’re unable to keep up with daily responsibilities, or do they feel more like an intense reaction to the stress?

I feel like it is a bit of both, honestly. It definitely feels like an incredibly intense reaction to what happened, but at the same time, it has made it quite hard to focus on my usual daily routine.
Before this stressful event, were you already feeling depressed or losing interest in things, or did all of these symptoms begin only afterward?

No, I wasn't feeling like this at all before. All of these symptoms started only after the stressful event occurred, and I've been experiencing them for about three weeks now. Before that happened, I didn't have any of these feelings.
Can you tell me what the stressful event was that happened three weeks ago?

I'm not really sure how to pin it down to one specific event, as it feels more like a lot of general life stress that built up and finally boiled over three weeks ago. It has just been a very overwhelming combination of things lately that I'm struggling to process.
